S04.text: The 20% plan changes overnight. About 24 hours and 48 minutes later, at 11:04 AM on July 14th, Trump made another post. He said the 20% plan would be replaced by trade and investment projects between Gulf States and the US. He cited very productive discussions with Middle Eastern leaders. He also said no one should charge ships in the Strait. He said he disliked fees. The change was sudden, but the.States must stay separate to understand the oil move. On July 13th, Brent rose 9.59% and settled at $83.30. Reuters linked that rise to concern about a US sea blockade of Iran. The blockade was planned for the next day. Reuters also linked it to energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
